messages:
marco: Heads up, eu-west promote hung at 60% during image pull verification. deploy-bot: canary paused by policy (image-digest-mismatch). details: image registry mismatch between eu-west mirror and central.
sophie: wait, mirror has older digest? I saw eu-central pulled sha256:aaa111, eu-west tried sha256:bbb222 and failed checksum.
marco: right. our image promotion pipeline pushed tag 2026.03.22 to central but eu-west mirror lagged. chart bump included new sidecar with that tag.
anjali: ops: mirror sync is running but ETA ~45m. change window ends in 1h. do we wait or roll back?
release-bot: Release 2026-03-22-900: canary started at 1769994600. no traffic ramped above 10%.
sophie: traffic still low but pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff. If mirror fixes in 45m, deploy-bot auto unpause will resume, but the policy auto-rollback is 60m.
marco: options: 1) pin stable and abort promo (rollback to previous chart) 2) force-pull from central registry by overriding imagePullSecrets/registry endpoint in values (hotfix) 3) extend rollout timeout and wait for mirror (risky).
anjali: ops prefers not to change imagePullSecrets mid-window. security needs to review forced central pull.
sophie: how much effort to hotfix? small values override to use explicit image.digest and registry host -> ~10m to apply, but requires infra to whitelist central registry endpoint.
marco: also note the chart v5.1.0 includes a values change: helm values default changed to use sidecar.enabled: true. reverting that would avoid sidecar but still includes other changes.
release-bot: current slate: stable=chart v5.0.7, canary attempted v5.1.0.
sophie: I'm leaning rollback to v5.0.7 for eu-west to keep stability and re-run promotion once mirror confirmed. we can still publish a hotfix chart with pinned digest for next window.
anjali: agree. ops will monitor mirror, but rollback buys time.
marco: ok initiating rollback for eu-west canary now. deploy-bot: executing helm rollback release=api-euwest to revision=7
deploy-bot: rollback complete. pods restored to chart v5.0.7. healthchecks green.
sophie: pushing release notes blurb: "eu-west promotion of chart v5.1.0 paused due to image registry mirror lag causing image-digest mismatch. Canary rolled back to v5.0.7. Mirror sync in progress; re-promotion scheduled after verification."
marco: added action items: 1) infra to scrub mirror health and add alert if sync >10m, 2) registry team to enable digest pinning in promotion pipeline, 3) release owner to stage hotfix with explicit digest next window.
anjali: ops note: if mirror lag becomes frequent we'll consider making promotion pipeline wait-for-mirrors step mandatory.
sophie: thanks. re-run planned tomorrow 08:00 UTC. tagging @registry-team and @security for digest override review. :white_check_mark:
